backend/main.mo: Main Motoko actor for the SpiritualConnect backend, implementing user profiles, temple management, puja bookings, consultation appointments, orders, and chadhava entries with role-based access control via mixins for authorization and blob storage.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report mapping implemented feature IDs to their associated source files, components, and test IDs for features like new Spiritual Shop categories, Bhajan Library, Vrat Katha page, and other frontend additions.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: JSON dictionary of short summaries for frontend source files covering business numerology utilities, Lo Shu Grid components, dashboard pages, admin CMS, and payment result pages.
frontend/index.css: Global Tailwind CSS entry point that defines CSS custom properties for the design system's color tokens in both light and dark modes, including background, foreground, primary, chart, and sidebar variables.
frontend/index.html: Minimal HTML shell for the SpiritualConnect React app, mounting the app into a root div and loading the main TypeScript module entry point.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Root React application file that defines all client-side routes using TanStack Router, mapping paths to page components including shop, dashboard, bhajan library, vrat katha, holy books, and admin CMS.
frontend/src/components/AppointmentBooki: Form component for booking astrologer consultation appointments, handling date/time/topic selection and submitting via a React Query mutation with Internet Identity authentication.
Renders a static SVG birth chart wheel with 12 house divisions, zodiac symbols, and sample planet markers using hardcoded positions and colors.
frontend/src/components/BusinessLoShuGri: Provides a form to input a business name, computes its Lo Shu grid mapping via `mapNameToLoShu`, and displays present/missing numbers with interpretations.
frontend/src/components/BusinessNameAnal: Accepts a business name and optional owner DOB, runs `analyzeBusinessName` to compute Chaldean value, compatibility score, ruling planet, and lucky days, then displays the results.
frontend/src/components/CompanyNameGener: Form-driven component that generates numerologically favorable company names based on owner DOB, business purpose, and an optional keyword using `generateCompanyNames`.
frontend/src/components/DailyPanchang.ts: Displays today's Panchang data (tithi, nakshatra, yoga, karan, sunrise/sunset, shubh muhurat, and inauspicious times) using static placeholder data from `panchangData`, with a TODO to integrate AstrologyAPI.com.
Form for collecting birth details to generate a Kundli; saves the profile via ICP identity if logged in, then renders a `BirthChartWheel` with sample planetary positions, with a TODO for live API integration.
frontend/src/components/Layout.tsx: Main application layout component providing a sticky header with navigation links, mobile menu, shopping cart panel, authentication via Internet Identity, and a multi-section footer.
frontend/src/components/LogoColorGuidanc: Displays logo color and design guidance based on a selected Rashi (zodiac sign), showing lucky colors, auspicious symbols, design elements, and recommended fonts.
frontend/src/components/LoShuGrid.tsx: Renders a 3x3 Lo Shu numerology grid highlighting present/missing numbers and displays interpretations and remedies for missing numbers alongside strengths for present ones.
frontend/src/components/MobileNumerology: Calculates the Chaldean numerology value of a mobile phone number and displays the resulting number's ruling planet, description, strengths, and challenges.
frontend/src/components/NameCompatibilit: Computes and displays a numerology-based compatibility score between two people using their names and optional birth dates, with a circular progress indicator and match label.
frontend/src/components/NameCorrectionTo: Takes a business name, calculates its Chaldean numerology value, and suggests corrected name variants with more favorable numerological numbers.
frontend/src/components/PersonalNumerolo: A form component that calculates and displays personal numerology values (Moolank, Bhagyank, Name Number) from a user's name and date of birth, including a Lo Shu Grid visualization.
frontend/src/components/PrasadDeliveryFo: A form component for authenticated users to request home delivery of temple prasad, selecting a temple and providing address and mobile number, with a confirmation state on success.
A form component that allows authenticated users to book a puja at a selected temple by providing devotee details, puja type, and preferred date, showing a confirmation screen with a booking ID on success.
frontend/src/components/Rashifal.tsx: A horoscope component that lets users select a zodiac sign (rashi) and view daily, weekly, and yearly predictions using tabbed content.
frontend/src/components/ShoppingCartPane: A slide-in cart panel that displays cart items with quantity controls and triggers a Stripe checkout session for authenticated users.
frontend/src/components/StripePaymentSet: An admin-only component that shows a banner and modal for configuring Stripe payment settings (secret key and allowed countries) when Stripe is not yet configured.
frontend/src/components/VirtualAarti.tsx: A React component that renders an interactive virtual aarti experience, allowing users to light a diya, ring a bell, and blow a conch with animated visual feedback.
A React component for submitting virtual temple offerings (chadhava), letting authenticated users select a temple and offering items, then persisting the submission via a mutation hook.
frontend/src/components/VratCalendar.tsx: A React component that displays a month-navigable calendar of Hindu fasting days and festivals for 2026, color-coded by type (ekadashi, purnima, festival, etc.).
frontend/src/data/businessPurposeData.ts: Defines a TypeScript interface and static array of six business purpose categories (e.g., Wealth, Fame, Healing), each with favorable numerology numbers and Sanskrit keywords.
frontend/src/data/devotionalQuotes.ts: Exports a static array of devotional quotes from Hindu scriptures and Swami Vivekananda, each with optional English translation, source reference, and language tag.
frontend/src/data/logoGuidanceData.ts: Defines a TypeScript interface and static array mapping each zodiac rashi to logo design guidance including ruling planet, recommended colors, symbols, design elements, and font styles.
frontend/src/data/numerologyInterpretati: Defines a `NumberInterpretation` interface and exports an array of interpretations for numbers 1–9, each containing name, ruling planet, keywords, description, strengths, challenges, and Lo Shu grid position.
frontend/src/data/panchangData.ts: Defines a `PanchangData` interface and exports a `getTodayPanchang()` function that returns placeholder Hindu calendar data (tithi, nakshatra, yoga, muhurat timings, etc.) computed from the current date, with a TODO to replace it with a live API call.
frontend/src/data/rashifalData.ts: Defines a `RashiInfo` interface and exports a `RASHIS` array containing daily, weekly, and yearly horoscope text along with metadata (symbol, element, ruling planet, dates) for all 12 zodiac signs.
frontend/src/data/reportCatalogData.ts: Defines a `ReportCatalogItem` interface and exports a `REPORT_CATALOG` array listing 16 astrology report products with their id, name, description, price, category, delivery time, and icon.
frontend/src/data/reportOutputData.ts: Defines interfaces for planetary positions and report sections, and exports sample planetary position data along with pre-written detailed report content (e.g., birth chart, Sade Sati) keyed by report type.
frontend/src/data/vratCalendarData.ts: Defines a `VratDay` interface and exports a `VRAT_CALENDAR_2026` array of Hindu fasting days and festivals for 2026, each with a date, name, type, and description.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Custom hook that creates and caches an ICP backend actor using React Query, supporting both anonymous and authenticated (Internet Identity) usage, and invalidates dependent queries when the actor changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Provides an Internet Identity authentication context and provider component, exposing login/logout functions, identity state, and login status via a React context hook.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Defines React Query hooks for all backend data operations (CRUD) across entities like temples, puja bookings, astrologers, wallet, bhajans, and more, using the actor from useActor.
frontend/src/index.css: Global stylesheet that imports Google Fonts, sets up Tailwind layers, defines a spiritual/saffron/gold CSS custom property color palette for light and dark modes, and declares reusable component utility classes.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Application entry point that mounts the React app with QueryClientProvider and InternetIdentityProvider wrapping the root App component.
frontend/src/pages/AdminCMS.tsx: Password-protected admin CMS page with tabbed management interfaces for adding and deleting Bhajans, Vrat Kathas, and Holy Book entries, including file-to-base64 audio upload support.
frontend/src/pages/AstrologerConsultatio: Page that displays a grid of astrologer profiles (fetched from the backend or falling back to placeholders) with star ratings, specializations, and per-minute rates.
frontend/src/pages/AstrologerDashboard.t: Admin dashboard for astrologers protected by a passcode, allowing viewing and updating consultation appointments with status filtering and notes.
frontend/src/pages/AstrologerProfile.tsx: Displays a detailed profile page for an individual astrologer (fetched or from placeholder data) including ratings, specializations, and an appointment booking form.
frontend/src/pages/BhajanLibrary.tsx: A bhajan music player page with a mock library of Hindu devotional songs, supporting playback controls, search, shuffle, repeat, and lyrics display.
frontend/src/pages/BusinessNumerology.ts: A tabbed page offering business numerology tools including name analysis, logo color guidance, name correction, company name generation, and Lo Shu grid analysis.
frontend/src/pages/Dashboard.tsx: User dashboard requiring authentication, displaying tabbed sections for puja bookings, appointments, reports, orders, wallet balance/transactions, and chadhava/prasad offerings.
frontend/src/pages/DevotionalLibrary.tsx: A searchable devotional content library displaying static and backend-fetched mantras, aartis, bhajans, and chalisas with filtering by type and deity.
frontend/src/pages/HolyBooksAudio.tsx: A page that displays major Hindu scriptures (Bhagavad Gita, Ramcharitmanas, etc.) with chapter-by-chapter text and an audio player featuring play/pause, skip, and chapter navigation controls.
frontend/src/pages/Home.tsx: The main landing page featuring a hero banner, daily devotional quote, featured temples and products, platform feature highlights, and CTAs linking to bhajan library, vrat katha, and holy books sections.
frontend/src/pages/HoroscopePanchang.tsx: A tabbed page combining four astrological tools: Daily Panchang, Vrat Calendar, Rashifal, and Kundli Generator, displayed under a banner header.
frontend/src/pages/Numerology.tsx: A tabbed numerology page offering Personal Numerology, Mobile Numerology, and Name Compatibility analysis tools under a banner header.
frontend/src/pages/PaymentFailure.tsx: A payment failure confirmation page that informs the user no charges were made and provides links to return to the shop or dashboard.
frontend/src/pages/PaymentSuccess.tsx: A payment success confirmation page that clears the cart on mount and shows a success message with links to the dashboard and shop.
frontend/src/pages/ProductDetail.tsx: A product detail page that fetches and displays a single shop product's image, name, price, description, benefits, and astrological purpose, with quantity selection and add-to-cart functionality.
frontend/src/pages/ReportOutput.tsx: Displays a detailed astrological report page identified by route param `id`, showing a birth chart wheel, planetary positions table, and report sections from static data; renders a placeholder message if the report is not found.
frontend/src/pages/Reports.tsx: Lists the astrological report catalog grouped by category and provides a modal form for authenticated users to submit a personalized report request, which is persisted via a mutation hook.
frontend/src/pages/SpiritualShop.tsx: E-commerce page for spiritual products (gemstones, yantras, bracelets, etc.) with category filtering, fetching live products from the backend and falling back to placeholder data, with add-to-cart functionality.
frontend/src/pages/TempleServices.tsx: Temple services page with a tabbed interface exposing four sub-features: puja booking, virtual chadhava offerings, prasad delivery, and virtual aarti.
frontend/src/pages/VirtualTemple.tsx: Allows authenticated users to configure and save a personalized virtual home temple by selecting a deity, decor style, background, and offering items, with a live visual preview.
frontend/src/pages/VratKatha.tsx: Displays a searchable, filterable list of Hindu vrat (fast) stories with audio playback support, using mock katha data and a backend query hook for real entries.
frontend/src/stores/cartStore.ts: Zustand store with persistence for a shopping cart, supporting add/remove/update quantity operations and computed totals for items and price.
frontend/src/utils/businessNumerology.ts: Provides business name analysis using Chaldean numerology, returning compatibility scores, lucky days/colors/gemstones, and recommendations based on the owner's date of birth.
frontend/src/utils/chaldeanNumerology.ts: Core Chaldean numerology utilities including letter-to-number mapping, name number calculation, Moolank/Bhagyank from DOB, ruling planet lookup, compatibility scoring, and name suggestions.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Utility functions for extracting URL parameters from both query strings and hash-based routes, with sessionStorage persistence helpers for sensitive values like admin tokens.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind CSS configuration defining a spiritual-themed design system with custom saffron, gold, maroon, and cream color palettes, Cinzel/Lato fonts, and plugins for typography, container queries, and animations.
project_state.json: Project state manifest describing a comprehensive spiritual/astrology platform MVP with features spanning temple services, horoscope, astrologer booking, shop with Stripe, numerology, and devotional content, along with architectural notes and image requirements.
